definition: On the same carrier and with the same upstream orientation, every per se efficient-cause edge belongs to the relation whose causal history is being studied.
note: Unattributed analyst vocabulary for #367, not a reading of Pruss or Koons. This is relation inclusion, not an event-to-being identification. A source reading on events needs a separately defended translation before applying to Aquinas on beings. Source scope and remaining gaps: docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md.
